name: drawer
props: Panel content (usually DrawerItems); scrolls between header and footer.
Pinned above / below the content (DrawerProfile, DrawerHeader, DrawerFooter…).
The screen the drawer belongs to. Enables edge swipe and push; without children the drawer opens in a Modal.
Called on drags, scrim tap, Android back and Escape.
Panel width in points or percent of the container (max 360).
Slide over a dimmed screen, or shrink the screen to a rounded 0.92 card and slide it aside (inline only).
Swipe in from the edge to open (needs children). Taps in the edge zone still reach the screen.
Close on scrim tap and drag.
Overlay variant: scale the screen behind to 0.96 with rounded corners while open (inline).
Light impact on open; DrawerItems tick on press.
Space above the header / below the footer — pass safe-area insets for exact values.
{ name, email?, src?, status?, layout?: 'row' | 'stacked', onPress?, accessory? }
Account block: soft solid initials (or image) avatar with presence dot, name and email; pressable as an account / workspace switcher.
Title chrome for the header slot.
{ label, icon?, badge?, badgeTone?, active?, tone?, onPress?, closeOnPress?, accent?, haptics?, trailing?, disabled? }
Nav row with a spring-in accent-tinted active pill, popping icon and count badge (neutral plain count / accent tinted pill / danger solid pill); tone="danger" for Log out.
Quiet heading between groups with a hairline divider above (divider={false} for the first group) and an optional trailing node.
{ label, detail?, icon?, progress?, onPress?, trailing? }
Compact footer row, e.g. a storage meter.
The drawer's line icons, for menu buttons and headers.
Control the surrounding Drawer from inside it.
